grades.question: For two Spirits, how are the Fear pool/deck and Invader deck prepared, what initial Blight pool is used with and without a Blight Card, and what final Invader action completes setup?

expected.answer: Use 8 Fear markers, 9 shuffled Fear cards divided 3/3/3 by Terror II and III dividers; Invader deck is 3 Stage I above 4 Stage II above 5 Stage III, randomized within each stage with one unused card per stage removed unseen. Initial Blight is 5 with a Healthy Island card (2 per player +1), or 11 without (5 per player +1). Setup Explore the top card normally and leave it face-up in Build; Ravage is initially empty.

observed.answer: For two Spirits, the Fear Pool starts with 8 markers (4 per Spirit). Use 9 Fear Cards: three, Terror II divider, three, Terror III divider, three; start at Terror I. For the Invader deck, remove one card of each stage unseen, then stack 3 Stage I, 4 Stage II and 5 Stage III cards; place the 12-card deck in Explore. With a Blight Card, use 2 per Spirit plus 1 additional total (5 for two Spirits) on its Healthy side. Without a card, use the printed pool of 5 per Spirit plus 1 total (11 for two Spirits). Reveal and resolve the top Invader card as the initial Explore, then put it face-up in Build; that Explore completes setup and Ravage starts empty.
observed.evidence: Setup: “4 Fear markers per Spirit”; Fear Cards are “three cards, Terror II divider, three cards, Terror III divider, three cards.” Invader deck setup specifies “3 Stage I…4 Stage II…5 Stage III.” Blight setup says “2 Blight per Spirit plus exactly 1 additional Blight total”; intro alternative says “5 Blight per Spirit +1 total.” Initial Explore is last part of setup; put it “face-up in Build.”

grades.reason: Both answers give all numerical amounts, composition, stage order, unseen removals, and initial Explore, but neither states shuffling Fear cards or independently randomizing each Invader stage. Preparation explicitly includes these procedures, so both are partial; correct counts do not imply a randomized deck.
requested_parts: 8 Fear markers
9 Fear cards randomized and separated 3/3/3 by Terror dividers
Invader stages randomized separately; remove one unseen per stage; stack 3 I above 4 II above 5 III
Initial Blight 5 with Healthy card or 11 without
Initial normal Explore; revealed card face-up in Build
missing_requested_material_facts: Shuffle/randomize Fear cards before forming the 3/3/3 deck
Shuffle/randomize each Invader stage separately before unseen removal and stage stacking
extra_key_explanation: Ravage starts empty is useful setup-state explanation; no extra omission penalty for reader B, because the question asks the final Invader action and the answer gives initial Explore to Build.
